detail.longDescription:
Step into Bible stories through cinematic, full-screen short videos made for thoughtful, easy viewing.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Swipe through an immersive vertical feed of Bible story videos.
• Explore complete Story Journeys from the New and Old Testaments.
• Open any series, choose an episode, and follow each chapter in order.
• Save meaningful stories to Favorites and return to them later.
• See where you left off during your current app session.
• Share a story through your favorite apps.
• Set a local daily Bible reminder at the time you choose.
• Continue watching in Picture in Picture on supported Android devices.

WHY BIBLE SHORTS

• Cinematic storytelling brings familiar Bible moments to life in a focused format.
• Structured series connect individual episodes into a complete journey.
• A calm, distraction-free experience has no social feed, comments, uploads, or advertising.

Bible Shorts requires an internet connection to load and play its remote video library. Available stories and Picture in Picture support may vary by content, device, and system settings.
